nom: KORRES Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the cleanser balances a T-zone without over-stripping and, for some, helps keep shine and pimples down, though one oily/rosacea user says her skin turns red and dry within days of stopping.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently describe the cleanser as non-stripping and hydrating, though a couple of dry-skin reviewers found it drying or breakout-inducing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it balances oily T-zones with drier cheeks and helps with hormonal acne, describing it as gentle enough for both areas.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea, eczema or lupus, report no irritation, reduced redness and no dryness, though one sensitive-skin reviewer says it caused a bad breakout after a month of use.
segments.mature: A few reviewers in their 30s-50s describe it as effective and non-drying for mature skin, with one 54-year-old and one 50-year-old both calling it a staple despite ongoing adult acne.

concerns.aging: The few mature reviewers (50s) report the cleanser keeps their skin clean and moisturized without singling out anti-aging effects specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin say it cleanses without stripping or tightness and leaves skin soft and hydrated; a minority found it drying, and one described her skin feeling 'dry but clean' after use.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report visible reduction in facial redness and calming of rosacea-prone skin over days to weeks; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive, eczema-prone or lupus-affected skin describe the cleanser as unusually non-stripping and compatible with a compromised barrier, with several noting no reaction at all.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers say small red spots or forehead bumps clear up with continued use; this is a minority observation among the reviews.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, calmer skin, or acne staying at bay with continued use, but several others report the opposite — comedogenic-suspected breakouts, cystic-style reactions, or a worsening over a month of use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination-skin reviewers describe the cleanser as lightweight and non-greasy, with one noting it kept her T-zone controlled enough that her glasses stopped slipping.

aspects.libelle: Rich foaming lather from small amount
Skin feels soft and smooth after rinse
High price relative to drugstore options

extraits.texte: I reeeaallly wanted to like this product, but unfortunately if you have sensitive skin this is most likely not the product for you. I had relatively clear skin, but during the winter i struggle with dry skin so i tried this and i regret it. My skin broke out terribly. Because it can take some time for our skin to adjust to a new product, i continued to use but it just kept getting worse. After a month of this product, when i took it out of my routine my skin started clearing up. This is an expensive product that is definitely a risk if you have sensitive skin.

My skin is combination but now in my 30s, it is more dry. I also have rosacea and my skin is very sensitive. I usually cannot do foaming cleansers at all because as I've gotten older, they are just too drying. I'm amazed that this is a foaming cleanser that actually feels moisturizing to my skin, not drying at all. It also smells SO good to me. I can't even describe the scent, almost like cloves or cardamom. I get so excited to use this cleanser.

This has become my go-to facial cleanser which I come back to no matter what other products I try. A small amount builds into a luxurious creamy foam lather that feels so soothing. I have extremely sensitive skin but this does not irritate it one bit and my face feels so soft, smooth, clean after rinsing, with no tightness, dry patches or flakes that other cleansers often give me. I've also noticed it calms down my redness slightly. The tube lasts ages because of the tiny amount you need - honestly if you're using more than a pea size it's too much. The scent is mild but very pleasant; it doesn't smell like Yoghurt like the Korres Superdose face mask if you're wondering. For me this is worth purchasing full price because my skin adores it.

I tried so so many cleansers in the years of my skincare journey and everything was usually meh but this cleanser is perfect. I use it after micellar water as a second cleanser and it never irritiwtes my skin never dries it out lathers well and is just perfect and I have extremely sensitive skin with rosacea. I found double cleansing with oil to be harsh so this method is what i use at night and its gentle to use in the morning too. I have repurchased 3 times already

extraits.titre: Love this face wash for my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I've been using this product for a couple of years now. I knew I had a great product but sometimes you don't appreciate what you have until it's gone. I ran out a few days ago and my face is screaming. It's so red and dry. My skin type is oily and I have rocesia. I'll be stocking up on this product and be sure not to run out again.

i first got a tester of this cleanser in a birchbox, and i immediately fell in LOVE with it. everything from the minimalistic packaging to how well it lathers on my face. i have oily combination skin (oily in t-zone but normal on the cheeks), and usually when i switch cleansers, i get a pimple, but then it goes away after a few days. this cleanser gave me one pimple (that's just how my skin reacts to new cleansers lol), but after a while and once my skin got used to it, i noticed a brighter complexion, and my acne went down. i like how it is hydrating enough for my oily skin!! also bonus points because i have never had a face cleanser that actually leaves me hydrated after i get out of the shower!! because usually my regular face cleanser (when i use it in the shower) leaves me with a dry face, like it has stripped all my natural oils out of my skin. but with this cleanser, it doesn't dry me out!! (tip, always get the travel size or sample size first so you will know how your skin will react to it!! have a blessed day!)

This face wash made my skin so soft but after a few days of use I started to break out a little. Not sure if it's the face wash or something else. I'm going to try using it again in a few days and see if the same thing happens.
